programs.title: Come Dine With Me
programs.desc: Slain is hoping to prove that vegans do eat normal food with a classic British menu but with living doll Ms Lydon causing trouble, the night is set to be anything but normal.

programs.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
programs.desc: Adam is joined by chef Alastair McLeod and urban gardener Connie Cao for a big ole garden harvest.

programs.title: Cheese Slices
programs.desc: Camembert is a potent symbol of French cheese making and is copied all over the world. Will visits the tiny village of Camembert where it all began, and the nearby dairy of Monsieur Durand.

programs.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
programs.desc: Justine whips up a coconut milk sorbet, shows you how to roast a whole duck, served up with cherries and has Dario D'Agostino in to make his delicious seafood zuppa dell'adriatico.

programs.title: Destination Flavour Japan Bitesize
programs.desc: Adam Liaw trolls the restaurants of food-crazy Tokyo to find food as diverse as Yakitori made from the reproductive organs of chickens to a degustation delight called 'soil 2013'.

programs.title: Buddy Valastro's Cake Dynasty
programs.desc: The Mother's Day rush is one of the busiest times of the year, and Buddy is stressed! He needs to create a custom cake for the 50th Anniversary of Secretariat's Triple Crown win.
